start: A new online gym, owner signed in, nothing set up

steps.action: Tap 'Set up your gym' at the top of the menu (it shows a ring and a count like '0/8')
user_sees: Page 'Set up your gym', 'Finish these steps and your gym is ready for members.', a ring with '{done} of {total} done', and the steps: 'Add your plans', 'Bring in your members', 'Add your logo and colours', 'Add your staff and trainers', the online step, 'Set your gym timings', 'Print the check-in poster', 'Send members the app link'
must_not: The page or its menu row shown to staff
A step ticked that was not done
A count on the menu row that differs from the page

steps.action: Tap 'Add your plans', add one plan
user_sees: The Plans page with a bar offering 'Next step: Bring in your members' and 'Back to the list'; back on the list the step is ticked by itself
must_not: The plans step ticked while every plan is off sale
The bar shown after all steps are done

steps.action: Tap 'Add your logo and colours', come back without saving, tap 'Mark done' on it
user_sees: The step ticked; the ring moves on
must_not: A hand tick lost on reload
A tick that cannot be seen on the menu ring

user_sees: 'All done. Your gym is ready for members.'; the ring and count leave the menu
must_not: The page stuck at one less than the total
The row kept at the top of the menu after all is done

start: Set up your gym list, online gym (entry: the online journey)

user_sees: A page with 'Three parts, in order: your free web page, your one link and QR poster, and how people pay.' (or 'Two parts, in order: your join link and QR poster, and how people pay.' when the gym cannot edit a page)
must_not: The page part shown when gym web pages are closed or HQ switched this gym's page off
A browser-only or demo gym reaching this page instead of being sent back to the list

steps.action: In 'Your free web page' tap 'Make my page', fill it, tick 'Show my page to visitors', save and come back
user_sees: 'Your page is on. People can open it at {address}.' with 'Edit your page' and 'Turn off my page'
must_not: 'Your page is on' while visitors get nothing
Members, money or staff shown on the page

steps.action: In 'Your one link and QR poster' tap 'Copy link', 'Send on WhatsApp', 'Print poster' and 'Download picture'
user_sees: The link in a box with 'This is your gym’s one link. It opens your web page on a phone or a computer, and its “Become a member” button opens your join form.'
'Link copied.' / 'Poster saved as a picture.'
'✓ You have shared your link.'
must_not: A QR that opens another gym
A poster with a broken logo
'You have shared your link' before any share

user_sees: 'Pay at the gym desk': 'People who ask to join online pay at your desk on their first visit. Then you make them a member on Today.'; 'Pay online when they join' only when that is switched on at MettleUp; 'UPI at the desk' with the saved UPI ID or 'Add UPI ID'; then '✓ This step is done. You can come back here at any time.'
must_not: 'Pay online when they join' offered while the server switch is off
Another gym's UPI ID shown

start: Today or any page, steps left (entry: the menu row and the step bar)

steps.action: Open a step's screen from the list, then use the bar '‹ Back to “{step}”', 'Next step: {step} ›' and 'Back to the list'
user_sees: The bar on the step's screen; on the last step 'This is the last step on the list.'
must_not: The bar shown to staff
The bar pointing at a step that is not on this gym's list

start: Set up your gym, things that cannot be done yet

steps.action: Open the online journey with no plan people can pick
user_sees: 'Your join link works once your gym has at least one plan that people can pick. Add one in Plans.' with 'Open Plans'; no link and no poster
must_not: A link or QR that opens a join form with nothing to pick

steps.action: Tap 'Copy link' in a browser that blocks copying; tap 'Download picture' when the picture fails
user_sees: 'This browser blocked copying. Select the text and copy it.' / 'Could not make the picture. Try Print poster.'
must_not: 'Link copied.' when nothing was copied

steps.action: Tap 'Turn off my page' with no internet
user_sees: 'Your page could not be turned off. Check your internet and try again.'
must_not: 'Your page is off.' while visitors still see it

steps.action: Sign in as staff and type the address /setup
user_sees: Staff are kept off the page; the online journey shows nothing for staff
must_not: The owner's list of jobs shown to staff
A blank page with no way back

start: Set up your gym with steps left

steps.action: Tap 'Move this page to the bottom of the menu'
user_sees: The row moves down; 'You can still open it from Your gym in the menu.'; the page offers 'Show this page at the top of the menu again'
must_not: The page lost from the menu
Ticks lost by moving it

steps.action: In the online journey tap 'Not now' on the web page, later 'Turn my page on'; then 'Turn off my page'
user_sees: 'Your web page is off. Your one link below opens the join form instead.' and 'To turn it on, open your page, tick “Show my page to visitors” and save.'; 'It is your choice. You can turn your page on or off here at any time.'
must_not: A printed poster that stops working when the page is turned on or off
The step counted as not done only because the owner chose 'Not now'

user_sees: 'MettleUp has taken your page down, so visitors cannot see it. Open your page to read MettleUp’s note.' with 'Open your page'
must_not: 'Your page is on' shown for a page taken down

steps.action: Archive the only member and retire the only plan after the steps were ticked
user_sees: The members and plans steps go back to not done, the ring count drops
must_not: A hand tick undone by this
The count going below zero

steps.action: Read what the link, the poster and the web page show to the public
user_sees: The gym's fees, timings, photos and address; a QR with the gym's link only
must_not: Members' names, money or staff on the page or poster
The owner's key or the join code of another gym in the link
The page shown in Google when the owner did not tick it
